thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HOT: gpu-hotpool-3 queue depth 98% in prod-eu-1. 429 spike to ~12% over last 2m. Autoscaler failing to scale (rejected scale_up requests). Paging on-call.

anna-oncall: ack — I'm on it. checking autoscaler + rate policies. @simon-sre are you available?

simon-sre: I'm up. pulling autoscaler logs. quick snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:00:12Z scaler: scale_up rejected: quota_exceeded (max_vms=12)
2026-03-15T10:00:13Z scaler: pending_queue=980
```

nina-eng: autoscaler config shows org hard limit 12 GPUs in prod-eu-1. infra will need to approve if we want to raise. time to approval ~15-30m. meanwhile we should reduce low-priority consumption and reweight token buckets.

anna-oncall: plan: 1) temporarily reallocate token-bucket capacity to favor high tiers 2) enable model fallback/canary for non-critical routes 3) request quota bump from infra. I'll execute token changes now.

devops-bot: Executing: `PATCH /internal/ratepolicies/prod-eu-1` payload applied -> 200 OK

anna-oncall: Applied changes: bumped `prod-eu-1-high` bucket capacity 200->600, reduced `prod-eu-1-low` 200->50. Monitoring impact.

maya-support: FYI — customer-ops reporting two enterprise accounts seeing increased 429s and partial embedding failures. Raising priority and notifying them of active mitigation.

leo-ml: Recommend enabling fallback to `gptq-4-small` for heavy embedding routes while hotpool is saturated. Canary 10% to start.

anna-oncall: Enabling canary rollout for fallback model: `POST /api/rollouts` -> `rollout_id=rl-558` (canary 10%)

simon-sre: autoscaler still blocked by quota (infra loop). but tokenbucket change reduced 429 rate from ~12% -> ~4% within 5m. queue length dropping: 980 -> 420 -> 180.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Metrics update: 429 rate now 3.8%, queue depth 180, avg tail-latency improving. Keep an eye for regressions for 30m.

customer-ops: Notified affected customers with status note and ETA. They requested RCA and any credits; will coordinate with finance.

anna-oncall: Handoff: Simon — please take on-call for next 2h for follow-up and ensure autoscaler quota request completes. Nina — please own post-incident tuning and docs.

simon-sre: Taking the handoff. Opening incident ticket IT-3290 for quota + scaling runbook updates. Attaching logs.

nina-eng: Follow-ups I'm assigning: - lower default low-tier bucket to 50 - add autoscaler alert on `scale_up rejected: quota_exceeded` - add tokenbucket auto-reserve on hotpaths. I'll open PR after triage.

anna-oncall: Thanks team. Closing real-time mitigation channel. Will publish timeline & impact in IT-3290 and schedule postmortem. Label: gpu-hotpool-backpressure-tokenbucket-mitigation.

incident-bot: :page_with_curl: Postmortem assigned to nina-eng, severity P2, SLA for draft 72h. Further updates will be in IT-3290.
